action_summary: Round 17's next step -- a reachability decision for parts whose conditions compare against structure -- implemented as the field's own best model-free mechanism, input-to-state correspondence (REDQUEEN / CmpLog; Halo turns it into a filter at 43% reachable inputs vs AFLGo's 5.3%). Every single-operator comparison in the enclosing scope is instrumented so each side evaluates once, every call in boolean position logs its arguments and result (CmpLog hooks strcmp for the same reason), the pairs from the comparison that returned FALSE closest to the target are harvested, the operand the seed does not appear in is delivered by SUBSTITUTION into the seed at the position it occupies, and the reached input becomes the next round's seed with progress measured as DISTANCE to the target. It is composed with round 17's mutation engine rather than replacing it. Result: 0 additional pins, closest approach 9 lines, 4 of 8 parts refused because no gate fires on the seed's path. Four instrument defects were fixed before the zero was believed.
